note: Stage 2 and 3 times are measured from Strava. Stage 1 remains an estimate — that ride is still on the head unit and has not synced.

banner.title: Stage 3 done — French Pass at sunrise, as planned
banner.body: Mount Guyot finished at 14:04. 39.4 miles and 6,043 feet over French Pass, Georgia Pass and the Continental Divide — 6:38 of riding against a planned 7:30. Three stages down, 115 miles in, resting now before Aqueduct. All three stages so far have been ridden faster than the schedule; the time lost is entirely to Wednesday afternoon's weather hold.
